rows.label: bf10240150_0010
rows.name:
When people lose something,
they try to find a reason.

rows.label: bf10240150_0020
rows.name:
They look within themselves
and within others...

rows.label: bf10240150_0030
rows.name: They want someone else to define...

rows.label: bf10240150_0060
rows.name: Yet perhaps that, too, is human...
